Caribou Burgers
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 10:26am

Ingredients




1 pound Ground caribou
4 ounces Ground pork
Salt
Fresh ground black pepper
medium Onion, chopped
Bread crumbs or other cereal optional
Your favorite burger spices, 1 Egg, to bind the ingreds

Preparation

1 Because caribou has so little fat, you'll need to add some pork for a juicy burger. 2 Mix all the ingredients handling as little as possible. Heat grill or broiler. 3 Brush burgers with vegetable oil and grill about 4 minutes; turn and cook todesired doneness. Serve on rolls with your choice of condiments.
